build_wasm_bindings: build WASM bindings for MuJoCo using BindingBuilder with a C++ template path
create_binding_builder: create a BindingBuilder instance initialized with a C++ template file path
set_enum_bindings: set enum bindings by generating and inserting them into the binding builder
set_struct_bindings: set struct bindings by generating and inserting them into the binding builder
set_function_bindings: set function wrappers and bindings by generating non-excluded function bindings
